mapper.select: select distinct qr.question_id, qr.id as revision_id from cm_question_revision qr where qr.status='published' and exists ( select 1 from cm_question_knowledge qk where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qk.knowledge_point_id in #{id} ) and ( (select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id and kp.del_flag='0' where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id)=0 or (select count(*) from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id and kp.del_flag='0' where qk.question_revision_id=qr.id and qk.relation_role='primary')<>1 ) order by qr.id
mapper.update: update cm_question_revision qr set status='draft',row_version=row_version+1, review_opinion=null,published_by=null,published_time=null, update_by=#{operatorId},update_time=now() from (values (#{row.revisionId}::bigint) ) as v(revision_id) where qr.id=v.revision_id and qr.status='published'
mapper.insert:
insert into cm_question_revision_event( id,question_id,question_revision_id,event_type,from_status,to_status,opinion,operator_id,request_id,trace_id ) values
(#{row.eventId},#{row.questionId},#{row.revisionId},'question_offline','published','draft', '考纲更新导致知识点关联失效',#{row.operatorId},#{row.requestId},#{row.traceId})

insert into cm_business_audit_log( id,operator_id,domain_code,action_code,target_type,target_id,before_data,after_data,trace_id ) values
(#{row.auditId},#{row.operatorId},'question','question_offline','question_revision',#{row.revisionId}, jsonb_build_object('schema_version','question_review_audit/1.0','status','published'), jsonb_build_object('schema_version','question_review_audit/1.0','status','draft', 'reason','考纲更新导致知识点关联失效','request_id',#{row.requestId}),#{row.traceId})
mapper.sql: with ranked as ( select q.question_code, q.exam_subject_id, q.create_by, r.*, row_number() over (partition by q.id order by case when r.status in ('draft','pending_review','rejected') then 0 when r.status='published' then 1 else 2 end, r.revision_no desc) display_rank from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id where q.del_flag='0' and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId} )
mapper.select: select cast(rr.question_id as varchar) question_id, cast(rr.id as varchar) revision_id, rr.revision_no, rr.question_code, cast(scope.syllabus_version_id as varchar) syllabus_version_id, case when sv.id is null then null else concat(ec.certification_name, ' - ', sv.version_name) end syllabus_version_name, rr.stem stem_summary, cast(rr.exam_subject_id as varchar) exam_subject_id, es.subject_name exam_subject_name, rr.question_type, rr.difficulty, rr.status, (rr.review_opinion is not null and btrim(rr.review_opinion) <> '') has_review_opinion, rr.update_time updated_time from ranked rr join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=rr.exam_subject_id left join lateral (select min(kp.syllabus_version_id) syllabus_version_id from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=rr.id) scope on true left join cm_syllabus_version sv on sv.id=scope.syllabus_version_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where order by case rr.status when 'rejected' then 1 when 'pending_review' then 2 when 'published' then 3 when 'draft' then 4 else 5 end, rr.update_time desc, rr.question_id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from ranked rr where
mapper.sql: q.id question_id, r.id revision_id, r.revision_no, r.row_version, q.question_code, q.exam_subject_id, es.subject_name exam_subject_name, es.certification_id, ec.certification_name, r.question_type, r.difficulty, r.estimated_seconds, r.stem, cast(r.answer as text) answer, r.analysis, r.common_mistakes, r.status, r.review_opinion, r.update_time updated_time, q.create_by, q.create_dept, r.content_hash, r.source_type, r.source_name, r.source_external_id, r.source_locator, r.authorization_status, r.authorization_note, r.knowledge_mapping_status
mapper.select: select from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where q.id=#{questionId} and q.del_flag='0' and r.id=#{revisionId} and r.id=(select id from ranked where question_id=#{questionId} and display_rank=1) and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId}

select from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where q.id=#{questionId} and r.id=#{revisionId} and q.del_flag='0' and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId} for update of q,r

select from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where r.id=#{revisionId} and q.del_flag='0' and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId} for update of q,r

select from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where r.id in #{revisionId} and q.del_flag='0' and q.create_by=#{visibleUserId} order by r.id for update of q,r

select from cm_question q join cm_question_revision r on r.question_id=q.id join cm_exam_subject es on es.id=q.exam_subject_id join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=es.certification_id where q.id=#{questionId} and r.status in ('draft','pending_review','rejected') limit 1
select id,option_label label,option_text content,sort_order from cm_question_option where question_revision_id=#{revisionId} order by sort_order
select id,image_order sort_order,source_url,alt_text alt,storage_path from cm_question_image where question_revision_id=#{revisionId} order by image_order

select qk.knowledge_point_id,concat(kp.syllabus_number,' ',kp.syllabus_title) knowledge_point_label,qk.relation_role,qk.sort_order,kp.syllabus_version_id,kp.exam_subject_id, not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point c where c.parent_id=kp.id and c.del_flag='0') leaf from cm_question_knowledge qk join cm_knowledge_point kp on kp.id=qk.knowledge_point_id where qk.question_revision_id=#{revisionId} order by qk.sort_order
select cast(id as varchar) id,subject_name label from cm_exam_subject where certification_id=#{certificationId} order by subject_code

select cast(sv.id as varchar) id,concat(ec.certification_name, chr(183), sv.version_name) label from cm_syllabus_version sv join cm_exam_certification ec on ec.id=sv.certification_id where sv.id=#{syllabusVersionId}

select kp.id knowledge_point_id,kp.syllabus_version_id,kp.exam_subject_id,not exists(select 1 from cm_knowledge_point c where c.parent_id=kp.id and c.del_flag='0') leaf from cm_knowledge_point kp where kp.del_flag='0' and kp.id in #{id}
select count(*) from cm_syllabus_version sv join cm_exam_subject es on es.certification_id=sv.certification_id where sv.id=#{syllabusId} and es.id=#{subjectId}

select (select count(*) from cm_collection_item ci join cm_question_revision r on r.id=ci.question_revision_id where r.question_id=#{questionId}) + (select count(*) from cm_session_question where question_id=#{questionId})
select count(*) from cm_question_revision where question_id=#{questionId} and status='published'
select count(*) from cm_question_revision where question_id=#{questionId}
select coalesce(max(revision_no),0)+1 from cm_question_revision where question_id=#{questionId}
mapper.update: update cm_question_revision set status=#{status},row_version=row_version+1,question_type=#{questionType},difficulty=#{difficulty},estimated_seconds=#{estimatedSeconds},stem=#{stem},answer=#{answer}::jsonb,analysis=#{analysis},common_mistakes=#{commonMistakes},content_hash=#{contentHash},semantic_hash=#{semanticHash},review_opinion=null,update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and row_version=#{rowVersion}
update cm_question_revision set status='pending_review',row_version=row_version+1,review_opinion=null,update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status in ('draft','rejected')

update cm_question_revision set status='published',row_version=row_version+1,reviewed_by=#{userId},reviewed_time=now(),review_opinion=null,published_by=#{userId},published_time=now(),update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status='pending_review'

update cm_question_revision set status='rejected',row_version=row_version+1,reviewed_by=#{userId},reviewed_time=now(),review_opinion=#{opinion},update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status='pending_review'

update cm_question_revision set status='draft',row_version=row_version+1,review_opinion=null,published_by=null,published_time=null,update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where id=#{revisionId} and status='published'
update cm_question set del_flag='1',update_by=#{userId},update_time=now() where id=#{questionId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_question_revision(id,question_id,revision_no,status,row_version,question_type,difficulty,estimated_seconds,stem,answer,analysis,common_mistakes,source_type,source_name,source_external_id,source_locator,authorization_status,authorization_note,content_hash,semantic_hash,knowledge_mapping_status,create_by,update_by) values(#{id},#{questionId},#{revisionNo},'draft',1,#{questionType},#{difficulty},#{estimatedSeconds},#{stem},#{answer}::jsonb,#{analysis},#{commonMistakes},#{source.sourceType},#{source.sourceName},#{source.sourceExternalId},#{source.sourceLocator},#{source.authorizationStatus},#{source.authorizationNote},#{contentHash},#{semanticHash},#{source.knowledgeMappingStatus},#{userId},#{userId}) on conflict (question_id) where status in ('draft','pending_review','rejected') do nothing
mapper.select: select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_status,cast(response_body as text) response_body from cm_idempotency_record where action_code=#{action} and request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,resource_type,resource_id,expires_time) values(#{id},#{action},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing',#{resourceType},#{resourceId},#{expiresTime}) on conflict (action_code,request_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select id,payload_hash,status,resource_id,response_status,cast(response_body as text) response_body from cm_idempotency_record where request_id=#{requestId} and action_code in ('approve_question_revision','reject_question_revision','offline_question_revision')
mapper.insert: insert into cm_idempotency_record(id,action_code,request_id,payload_hash,status,resource_type,resource_id,expires_time) values(#{id},#{action},#{requestId},#{payloadHash},'processing','question',#{questionId},#{expiresTime}) on conflict do nothing
